summary.text: Jack Martins is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 7 on Long Island, and Ballotpedia says his current term ends on January 1, 2027.
Wikipedia says he previously served as Mayor of Mineola and was first elected to the Senate in 2010.

paragraphs.text: Wikipedia says Martins is a first-generation Portuguese American who was born in Queens and raised in Mineola.
He graduated from Chaminade High School, received a bachelor's degree in political science from American University in 1988 and a J.D. from St. John's University School of Law in 1991.
He was elected mayor of the Village of Mineola in 2003, served until 2010, and lost a 2008 race for Congress against Representative Carolyn McCarthy.
In 2010 he defeated incumbent state Senator Craig M. Johnson by 451 votes, according to Wikipedia.
Wikipedia says he has chaired the Senate's Labor Committee and previously chaired the Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business Committee and the Local Government Committee.
